description: This file declares functions and includes necessary headers for monitoring functionalities related to 'wld' in the project. It contains function prototypes for initializing, destroying, updating, debugging, stopping, and setting parameters of a monitor object.

methods.name: wld_mon_initMon
methods.description: Initializes a monitor object with provided parameters.

methods.name: wld_mon_destroyMon
methods.description: Destroys a monitor object, freeing resources.

methods.name: wld_mon_writeActive
methods.description: Sets the active state of the monitor.

methods.name: wld_mon_sendUpdateNotification
methods.description: Sends an update notification with specified event object, name, and variant.

methods.name: wld_mon_debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information for the monitor.

methods.name: wld_mon_setEnable_pwf
methods.description: Enables or disables the monitor based on new value.

methods.name: wld_mon_setInterval_pwf
methods.description: Sets the interval parameter for the monitor.
